package.name: image_view2
package.description: ROS 2 port of image_view2: a simple image viewer with draw-on features. The image_view2 node subscribes to an image and overlays ImageMarker2 markers (2D and 3D via camera_info + tf2), republishes the marked image, and supports mouse interaction (rectangle / series / line / poly / grabcut selection) driving screenpoint / rectangle / line / poly / mask topics and mode services, plus an optional calibration grid. The points_rectangle_extractor node extracts a rectangular region of an organized point cloud from a screenrectangle / screenpoint. Interfaces (MouseEvent, ImageMarker2, PointArrayStamped, ChangeMode) match the ROS 1 package (https://github.com/jsk-ros-pkg/jsk_common).
